shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/monument
curved incised lines suggesting a garment or body contour
justification: Both are upright monuments bearing low-relief figural carving, and A's incised disc and sweeping curved bands could belong to a body or costume element comparable to the garments in B, but this is a generic correspondence. B shows a fully articulated multi-figure scene with elaborate headdresses, held objects, legs, feet and glyph-like blocks, whereas A shows only a few isolated broad curves, a plain disc and a small boss with no legible figures or attributes.
